functions: Ages amounts owed into overdue-day buckets as at a date

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  AgeDebtorsλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Ages amounts owed into buckets by days overdue as at a date, with a row for each debtor when debtors are given*/
AgeDebtorsλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [Amounts],
    [DueDates],
    [AsAt],
    [Debtors],
    [Days],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →AgeDebtorsλ(Amounts, DueDates, AsAt, [Debtors], [Days])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Age amounts owed into buckets by days overdue as at a date.¶NOTES!         →Each cell of Amounts is one invoice or balance, due on the date in the¶               →same position of DueDates. Days overdue are AsAt less the due date; an¶               →amount due on or after AsAt is Current. Days are the upper limits of the¶               →overdue buckets, whole numbers rising from 1, and the last bucket takes¶               →everything older. Returns a header row, a row for each debtor in the¶               →order they first appear, and a Total row; without Debtors, the Total row¶               →alone. A blank amount is skipped. Unrounded.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit/blob/main/docs/workbook-use.md¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →27 Nov 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "Amounts        →(Required) The amount owed on each invoice or balance.¶" &
                            "DueDates       →(Required) The date each amount fell or falls due, the same shape as Amounts.¶" &
                            "AsAt           →(Required) The date to age the amounts at.¶" &
                            "Debtors        →(Optional) The debtor who owes each amount, the same shape as Amounts.¶" &
                            "Days           →(Optional) Upper limits of the overdue buckets in days. Defaults to {30,60,90}.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.AgeDebtorsλ({100;250;40}, DATE(2026, {6;5;7}, {1;15;31}), DATE(2026, 6, 30))¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→Total row: Current 40, 1-30 days 100, 31-60 days 250, Total 390¶" &
                            "→=oz.AgeDebtorsλ({100;250;40}, DATE(2026, {6;5;7}, {1;15;31}), DATE(2026, 6, 30), {""Ash"";""Bay"";""Ash""})¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→Ash: Current 40, 1-30 days 100; Bay: 31-60 days 250",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          ISOMITTED( Amounts),
    //  DueDates, and Debtors when given, match Amounts cell for cell
        ValidShape?,    IFERROR( AND( NOT( ISOMITTED( DueDates)), ROWS( DueDates) = ROWS( Amounts), COLUMNS( DueDates) = COLUMNS( Amounts),
                            IF( ISOMITTED( Debtors), TRUE, AND( ROWS( Debtors) = ROWS( Amounts), COLUMNS( Debtors) = COLUMNS( Amounts)))), FALSE),
        ShapeMessage,   "AgeDebtorsλ needs DueDates and Debtors the same shape as Amounts.",
        ValidAsAt?,     IFERROR( AND( NOT( ISOMITTED( AsAt)), ROWS( AsAt) = 1, COLUMNS( AsAt) = 1, ISNUMBER( AsAt)), FALSE),
        AsAtMessage,    "AgeDebtorsλ needs AsAt to be one date.",
    //  Days whole numbers rising from 1; omitted is 30, 60 and 90
        Limits,         IF( ISOMITTED( Days), {30,60,90}, TOROW( Days)),
        ValidDays?,     IFERROR( AND( ISNUMBER( Limits), Limits = INT( Limits), Limits >= 1,
                            IFERROR( AND( DROP( Limits, , 1) > DROP( Limits, , -1)), TRUE)), FALSE),
        DaysMessage,    "AgeDebtorsλ needs Days to be whole numbers rising from 1.",
    //  Each amount kept is a number with a date, which a blank due date is not; a blank amount is skipped
        Values,         TOCOL( Amounts),
        Due,            TOCOL( IF( ISBLANK( DueDates), "", DueDates)),
        Skip,           TOCOL( ISBLANK( Amounts)) + IFERROR( Values = "", FALSE) > 0,
        ValidValues?,   IFERROR( AND( Skip + ISNUMBER( Values) * ISNUMBER( Due) > 0), FALSE),
        ValuesMessage,  "AgeDebtorsλ needs a number for each amount and a date for each due date.",
    //  Procedure - bucket 1 is Current, then one for each limit and one beyond the last
        Over,           IF( Skip, 0, AsAt - Due),
        Width,          COLUMNS( Limits) + 2,
        Bucket,         IF( Over <= 0, 1, 2 + MMULT( --( Over > Limits), SEQUENCE( COLUMNS( Limits), 1, 1, 0))),
        Spread,         ( Bucket = SEQUENCE( 1, Width)) * IF( Skip, 0, Values),
        Ones,           SEQUENCE( Width, 1, 1, 0),
        Totals,         MMULT( SEQUENCE( 1, ROWS( Spread), 1, 0), Spread),
        TotalRow,       HSTACK( "Total", Totals, MMULT( Totals, Ones)),
    //  A row for each debtor in the order they first appear
        Kept,           NOT( Skip),
        Names,          TOCOL( IF( ISBLANK( Debtors), "", Debtors)),
        Body,           IF( OR( ISOMITTED( Debtors), SUM( --Kept) = 0), TotalRow,
                            LET( Keys, UNIQUE( FILTER( Names, Kept)),
                                ByDebtor, MMULT( --( Keys = TOROW( Names)) * TOROW( Kept), Spread),
                                VSTACK( HSTACK( Keys, ByDebtor, MMULT( ByDebtor, Ones)), TotalRow))),
        Lower,          TAKE( HSTACK( 0, Limits), , COLUMNS( Limits)) + 1,
        Header,         HSTACK( "Debtor", "Current", Lower & "-" & Limits & " days", "Over " & TAKE( Limits, , -1) & " days", "Total"),
        Result,         VSTACK( Header, Body),
    //  Return Result, help or a message
        Return,         IF( Help?, 2, IF( NOT( ValidShape?), 3, IF( NOT( ValidAsAt?), 4, IF( NOT( ValidDays?), 5, IF( NOT( ValidValues?), 6, 1))))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, ShapeMessage, AsAtMessage, DaysMessage, ValuesMessage)
    )
);
Tests a difference for a transposition, slide or wrong-side posting

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  DifferenceCheckλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Tests a difference for the usual causes: divisible by 9 for a transposition or slide, and half the difference posted on the wrong side*/
DifferenceCheckλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [Difference],
    [Amounts],
    [Tolerance],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →DifferenceCheckλ(Difference, [Amounts], [Tolerance])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Test a difference, such as an out-of-balance trial balance, for its usual causes.¶NOTES!         →Returns 5 rows of a label and a value: the difference; whether, in¶               →whole cents, it is divisible by 9, as swapping 2 digits or moving a¶               →decimal point leaves; half the difference, the size of an amount posted to¶               →the wrong side; and how many of Amounts equal the difference, as an¶               →amount left out would, and equal half of it. An amount equals one when¶               →their sizes are within Tolerance. Without Amounts the last 2 rows read¶               →not checked. A clue, not a finding: the cause is for the reviewer.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit/blob/main/docs/workbook-use.md¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →27 Nov 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "Difference     →(Required) One difference, such as total debits less total credits.¶" &
                            "Amounts        →(Optional) The amounts to search, such as the trial balance; blanks and text are ignored.¶" &
                            "Tolerance      →(Optional) The largest gap in size still counted as equal, 0 or more. Defaults to 0.005.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.DifferenceCheckλ(270)¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→Divisible by 9: TRUE; half the difference: 135¶" &
                            "→=oz.DifferenceCheckλ(-300, {1200;150;-75})¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→Amounts equal to the difference: 0; amounts equal to half: 1",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          ISOMITTED( Difference),
        ValidDifference?, IFERROR( AND( ROWS( Difference) = 1, COLUMNS( Difference) = 1, ISNUMBER( Difference)), FALSE),
        DifferenceMessage, "DifferenceCheckλ needs Difference to be one number.",
    //  Tolerance one number, 0 or more; omitted is half a cent
        Allowed,        IF( ISOMITTED( Tolerance), 0.005, Tolerance),
        ValidTolerance?, IFERROR( AND( ROWS( Allowed) = 1, COLUMNS( Allowed) = 1, ISNUMBER( Allowed), Allowed >= 0), FALSE),
        ToleranceMessage, "DifferenceCheckλ needs Tolerance to be one number, 0 or more.",
    //  Procedure - in whole cents, a transposition or slide leaves a multiple of 9
        Size,           ABS( Difference),
        Cents,          ROUND( Size * 100, 0),
        Nines?,         AND( Cents > 0, MOD( Cents, 9) = 0),
        Half,           Difference / 2,
    //  Count the numbers in Amounts whose size matches the difference or its half; TOCOL drops blank cells, which it would read as 0
        Unchecked?,     ISOMITTED( Amounts),
        Numbers,        IF( Unchecked?, 0, LET( All, TOCOL( Amounts, 1), ABS( FILTER( All, ISNUMBER( All), "")))),
        Matches,        LAMBDA( Target, IF( Unchecked?, "not checked", SUM( --( IFERROR( ABS( Numbers - ABS( Target)) <= Allowed, FALSE))))),
        Result,         HSTACK( {"Difference"; "Divisible by 9"; "Half the difference"; "Amounts equal to the difference"; "Amounts equal to half"},
                            VSTACK( Difference, Nines?, Half, Matches( Difference), Matches( Half))),
    //  Return Result, help or a message
        Return,         IF( Help?, 2, IF( NOT( ValidDifference?), 3, IF( NOT( ValidTolerance?), 4, 1))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, DifferenceMessage, ToleranceMessage)
    )
);
